answer: One defense is quadratic stake bonding. Every agent locks a bond that serves as its anchor; voting power grows as the square root of the bond, so splitting one balance into a thousand Sybil names cannot multiply influence. A quartz audit periodically forces each identity to sign with its unique key and pay a small fee, slashing any bond that fails. To flip a vote an attacker must fund a full bond plus bribe attestors for each forged onyx identity, so the cost rises faster than the stake they could steal.
